attempts.bug_summary: The generated handling for logical negation of user-defined predicates is emitted with the same configuration as ordinary user-defined predicates. As a result, generated builders can evaluate a LogicalNotUserDefined predicate without applying the required negation.

The generator emits the greater-than comparison for the GtEq predicate family instead of the greater-than-or-equal comparison. This affects records exactly equal to the predicate value while leaving the generated class structure and other predicate families unchanged.

The generated NotIn visitor cases are emitted using the multi-result handling mode rather than the ordinary predicate mode. This changes generated behavior for NotIn predicates when the associated column or predicate state involves repeated or otherwise multi-valued results.
